_meta.description: Golden evaluation set for the Personal AI Companion (Phase 1 Step 1.4b). Every item is answered from eval/seed_corpus.json — the synthetic personal memory the harness seeds into a fresh SQLite DB. No fact in any ground_truth exists outside the seed corpus. Unanswerable items were checked by hand against the full seed corpus; the hard negatives are plausible follow-ups whose specific answer was deliberately never stated.
_meta.categories: conversation_recall | reminder | todo | meeting | schedule | summary_request | paraphrase_recall | action_request | conversation | unanswerable
_meta.scoring: recall items: faithfulness (llm_check) + correctness (token-recall + all-MiniLM cosine vs ground_truth) for answerable; refusal signal for unanswerable. action_request / conversation items: agentic-routing only. All items: agentic-routing (expected_retrieve_needed / expected_route / expected_action_type vs AgenticOutput). disambiguation_tier is a report-breakdown dimension only, never scored. See eval/README.md.
